guard.note: L2 Hostility 3.0.18: ins = le.getAttribute(attr), return if null; id = L2Hostility.loc(name); new AttributeModifier(id, factor, op); hasModifier(id) -> removeModifier(id); addPermanentModifier(modifier); nothing else
ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath("l2hostility", name): a pure function of the name (kept per name)
removeModifier(id): out of modifierById, its operation map and permanentModifiers, then setDirty
addModifier(modifier), then permanentModifiers.put(id, modifier): the same object in both maps
modifierById.putIfAbsent (throws when held), operation map put, setDirty
getModifier(id): the id map read the check uses

l2hostility_trait_attribute_unchanged_sk.conversion: MixinExtras @ModifyExpressionValue on le.getAttribute(attr) (LivingEntity.getAttribute(Holder)) at the head of TraitManager.addAttribute (with the name, factor and operation arguments): null is answered (the method's own early return) when the instance holds, under l2hostility:name, a modifier with the same amount bits and operation that is also the permanentModifiers entry of that id, so the remove + add pair that would leave the modifiers equal does not run; otherwise the instance and the method as shipped. Exact variant: no dirty mark for an unchanged re-apply. Runtime flag l2hostilityTraitAttributeUnchangedSkip. Helper bons.furious.patch.l2hostility_coo49.L2TraitReapply (its own VarHandle on AttributeInstance.permanentModifiers; the Forge build reached the attribute_lookup group's AttributeReapply).
